query:
select jsonb_build_object(
'checked_at', now(),
'tables', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_name',c.relname,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity)) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('rankings','movie_lists','pack_progress','shared_lists','product_events','suggestion_packs','category_rankings','category_lists','category_pack_progress','category_shared_lists')),
'grants',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g)) from (select table_name,grantee,privilege_type from information_schema.table_privileges where table_schema='public' and grantee in ('anon','authenticated','PUBLIC') and table_name in ('rankings','movie_lists','pack_progress','shared_lists','product_events','suggestion_packs','category_rankings','category_lists','category_pack_progress','category_shared_lists') order by table_name,grantee,privilege_type) g),
'column_grants',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g)) from (select table_name,column_name,grantee,privilege_type from information_schema.column_privileges where table_schema='public' and grantee in ('anon','authenticated','PUBLIC') and table_name in ('shared_lists','category_shared_lists') order by table_name,column_name,grantee,privilege_type) g),
'policies',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) from (select tablename,policyname,roles,cmd,qual,with_check from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('rankings','movie_lists','pack_progress','shared_lists','product_events','suggestion_packs','category_rankings','category_lists','category_pack_progress','category_shared_lists') order by tablename,policyname) p),
'functions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',p.proacl,'result',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),'arguments',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),'body',p.prosrc,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'anon_execute',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticated_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'))) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('enforce_product_events_session_insert_limit','enforce_shared_lists_payload_fields','read_movie_share','read_dog_share')),
'triggers',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_name',c.relname,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid))) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where not t.tgisinternal and n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('shared_lists','product_events')),
'migrations',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name)) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version in ('20261009060218','20261009070637'))
) as metadata;

select s.slug, s.category,
    jsonb_build_object('items', s.payload->'items')
      || case when s.payload ? 'displayName'
        then jsonb_build_object('displayName', s.payload->'displayName')
        else '{}'::jsonb end
      || case when s.payload ? 'catalogVersion'
        then jsonb_build_object('catalogVersion', s.payload->'catalogVersion')
        else '{}'::jsonb end,
    s.created_at, s.updated_at
  from public.category_shared_lists as s
  where share_slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]{12}$'
    and s.slug = share_slug
    and s.category = 'dogs'
    and s.revoked_at is null;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.read_dog_share(share_slug text)
 RETURNS TABLE(slug text, category text, payload jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select s.slug, s.category,
    jsonb_build_object('items', s.payload->'items')
      || case when s.payload ? 'displayName'
        then jsonb_build_object('displayName', s.payload->'displayName')
        else '{}'::jsonb end
      || case when s.payload ? 'catalogVersion'
        then jsonb_build_object('catalogVersion', s.payload->'catalogVersion')
        else '{}'::jsonb end,
    s.created_at, s.updated_at
  from public.category_shared_lists as s
  where share_slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]{12}$'
    and s.slug = share_slug
    and s.category = 'dogs'
    and s.revoked_at is null;
$function$
